Summary.valueString: The video opens with a Flight Simulator plane flying over an island, introducing a collaboration with Microsoft Azure AI. A man in glasses explains the importance of good data for neural text-to-speech (TTS) and describes building a universal TTS model trained on 3,000 hours of data to capture audio nuances for natural voice generation. Visuals show audio waveforms and a data center, emphasizing the scale and technology behind the TTS model. The scene transitions to aerial views of landscapes and castles rendered in the simulator, showcasing the visual fidelity. Another man discusses the high fidelity and human-like quality of cognitive services' voices. The segment ends with realistic airport ground operations and an airplane preparing for pushback, highlighting the integration of AI voice technology in the simulation environment.

transcriptPhrases.speaker: Speaker 1
transcriptPhrases.text: When it comes to the neural TTS, in order to get a good voice, it's better to have good data.

transcriptPhrases.speaker: Speaker 2
transcriptPhrases.text: To achieve that, we build a universal TTS model based on 3,000 hours of data.

transcriptPhrases.speaker: Speaker 1
transcriptPhrases.text: We actually accumulated tons of the data so that this universal model is able to capture the nuance of the audio and generate a more natural voice for the algorithm.

transcriptPhrases.speaker: Speaker 3
transcriptPhrases.text: What we liked about cognitive services offerings were that they had a much higher fidelity.

transcriptPhrases.speaker: Speaker 3
transcriptPhrases.text: And they sounded a lot more like an actual human voice.
